stack.name: clinicaclick-integrations-prod-foundation
stack.status_explanation: The base stack was created successfully. A later update to add the missing ACTUAL 100% AWS Budget notification through CloudFormation rolled back because AWS Budgets reported a budget with the same name but a different internalId. The requested ACTUAL 100% notification was added directly with the AWS Budgets API and verified.
stack.cloudformation_drift_note: The local template now includes the ACTUAL 100% Budget notification, but the live CloudFormation stack template/resource state may not include that exact notification because it was added out of band after rollback.

inline_permissions: kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey and kms:GenerateDataKey only on the integrations secrets and payload KMS keys
logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents and logs:DescribeLogStreams only for /clinicaclick/integrations/prod/app streams
CloudFormation read/change-set/update actions only on clinicaclick-integrations-prod-foundation
read-only inventory for EC2, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch Logs, Secrets Manager metadata and SSM instance status
deployment_role.note: Trusted only to the temporary provisioning SSO role; do not use this as the habitual implementation access without approval.

cost_reader_role.note: Created for cost readback, but Cost Explorer availability and cost-allocation tag activation were not reverified after browser session expiry.

audit_writer_role.permissions: s3:PutObject under the audit bucket app/* prefix, s3:GetBucketLocation, and encrypt/data-key use of the audit KMS key only

audit_reader_role.permissions: read/list only under audit bucket app/* plus decrypt/describe for the audit KMS key

audit_retention_admin_role.permissions: manage audit bucket lifecycle, encryption, public access block and bucket policy; describe/get policy for audit KMS only; no object deletion and no KMS disable/delete

integrations_payload.key_arn: not captured after session expiry; retrieve from CloudFormation output PayloadKmsKeyArn or kms list-aliases before use

network_and_instance.ami: Amazon Linux 2023 latest from /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 at creation time
network_and_instance.ebs: 20 GiB gp3 encrypted root volume, DeleteOnTermination=true
network_and_instance.metadata_options: IMDSv2 required, endpoint enabled, hop limit 1, instance metadata tags disabled
network_and_instance.security_group: no inbound rules; egress TCP/443 to 0.0.0.0/0
network_and_instance.vpc: dedicated VPC 10.74.0.0/24; actual VpcId not captured after session expiry
network_and_instance.subnet: single public subnet 10.74.0.0/28 with MapPublicIpOnLaunch=false; actual SubnetId not captured after session expiry
network_and_instance.ssm_access: AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore on instance role; no SSH key pair configured by template

audit_bucket.name: clinicaclick-integrations-prod-foun-auditlogbucket-3fmfqc6v8ktu
lifecycle_effective: retain-current-audit-objects enabled; ExpirationInDays/NoncurrentDays=183 in template, NoncurrentDays=183 verified

cloudtrail.logging_status: IsLogging=true, delivery errors null when checked

budget_and_notifications.cloudformation_difference: The local template includes all three notifications. The live stack's CloudFormation-managed Budget resource may only represent the pre-rollback state; ACTUAL > 100% was added out of band via Budgets API.

cost_explorer_and_tags.missing: After the browser session expired, Cost Explorer readiness and activation of cost allocation tags could not be verified without reauthentication. Confirm in Billing/Cost Management before relying on tag-filtered budgets and reports.

fictitious_smoke_tests.audit_writer_put_object: passed using only non-clinical fictitious JSON under app/smoke-test/

implementation_codex_temporary_read_acce.recommended_model: IAM Identity Center SSO with a separate temporary permission set, not the admin provisioning permission set
implementation_codex_temporary_read_acce.proposed_scope: read infrastructure metadata and cost signals only; no SecretsManager GetSecretValue, no SSM StartSession, no SSM SendCommand, no writes, no deletes
implementation_codex_temporary_read_acce.proposed_assignment_target: Implementation Codex workforce user or group in IAM Identity Center for account 137819318729
implementation_codex_temporary_read_acce.approval_text: Autorizo crear el permission set SSO temporal codex-clinicaclick-impl-readonly-temp y asignarlo al usuario/grupo del Codex de implementacion en la cuenta 137819318729, con la politica minima de lectura descrita en propuesta-aprobacion.md. No autorizo access keys permanentes, permisos admin, lectura de valores de secretos, SSM StartSession/SendCommand ni cambios de infraestructura.

explicitly_not_done: no database access or encryption change
no production secrets, tokens, cookies or passwords read
required_closing_statement: Infraestructura de auditoria preparada; registro de actividad de ClinicaClick y revision del cifrado de su BD pendientes del Codex responsable de la aplicacion
